def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variant: 'chinstrap' -> 'Chinstrap'
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Fix island label variant: ' Torgersen' -> 'Torgersen'
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    # Fix body_mass_g out-of-range values (likely recorded in mg instead of g)
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in result.items()}
